question: By what means does the speaker come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine, and to whom is that acknowledgment addressed?
premises: The acknowledgment is addressed to the lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
That knowledge has come about by the grace of the one addressed.
inference: It is by the grace of the lord of the Kaulas that the speaker has come to know the Kaula determination.
uncertainties: The prior state of ignorance is implied but not explicitly detailed by this verse alone.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
